* '''Original''' ([[Phylo Gandish (V)]]): as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010; the surviving copy was re-made 4 April 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of March 15, 2010"; PDF dated 4 April 2010), page 5, slip 325. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. If opponent's [Virtual Block 6] card just added a destiny to total power or attrition here, draw two destiny, choose one, and subtract it from their attrition and total power. Your characters here are immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 3.” (the printed slip shows the pilot icon with 2). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-25-Phylo_Gandish.png]]) prints it; the Players Committee card image (PC-E1) and the Master List (PC-E2) repeat it. The PC website card list (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows the same text with the pilot icon written out.<ref name="cl-1263_26-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>. The Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata), says: “The phrase "(except battle destiny)" has been removed.”<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-16; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announcement date not found). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> No published text with that phrase has been found (the release sheet, the card image, the card list and the Master List all lack it), so no earlier version can be shown here. The sheet came out on 12 March 2010, and the surviving re-made copy (uploaded to the Players Committee site on 3 April 2010) lacks the phrase<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>; the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010 lacks it too<ref name="cdf-20100529-light">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100529” (lightside.cdf; card data, not a printed source), as committed on 13 July 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit 5047de0)</ref>. So if the first printing had it, it was removed between 12 March and 3 April 2010.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Phylo Gandish (V) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. If opponent's [Virtual Block 6] card just added a destiny to total power or attrition here, draw two destiny, choose one, and subtract it from their attrition and total power. Your characters here are immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 3.” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the original text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Phylo Gandish (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”; Light Side, p. 13)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=13, page 13. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=13 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. If opponent's [Virtual Block 6] card just added a destiny to total power or attrition here, draw two destiny, choose one, and subtract it from their attrition and total power. Your characters here are immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the original text. The Master List PDF was built on 3 February 2014, after the errata of 30 October 2013 (PC-E3), but it is placed at its cover date like every Master List text, and it does not print that errata. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 30 October 2013, effective immediately<ref name="forum-p847474">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 30 October 2013: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p847474 p847474] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. If opponent's [Virtual Block 6] or [Virtual Block 4] card just added a destiny to total power or attrition here (except battle destiny), draw two destiny, choose one, and subtract it from their attrition and total power. Your characters here are immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 3.” The post writes the pilot clause as “[P]2.” (icon notation). '''What changed:''' “or [Virtual Block 4]” was added, so that Phylo also counters Virtual Block 4 cards such as Galen's Lightsaber and Vader's Gift (the post: “as was originally intended”). The post also prints “(except battle destiny)”, which it treats as existing text, although the Advanced Rulebook 2.0 errata says the phrase had been removed and no earlier published text has it; this page follows the post.
